The '''Filby system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the title of the [[Baron of Filby]], which was held by [[Logan Erstar]] by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="LiveAction">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Filby [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
